description.raw: '''Innate:''' Periodically, '''Xerath''' empowers his next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] to restore [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] 30 – 225 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] mana, doubled to 60 – 450 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] against enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]].
description.text: Innate: Periodically, Xerath empowers his next basic attack on-hit to restore  30 – 225 (based on level)Category:Debug mana, doubled to 60 – 450 (based on level)Category:Debug against enemy champions.

description2.raw: ''Mana Surge's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown is reduced by 3.5 seconds whenever '''Xerath''' kills an enemy.
description2.text: Mana Surge's  cooldown is reduced by 3.5 seconds whenever Xerath kills an enemy.

description3.raw: ''Mana Surge does not trigger if '''Xerath''' would restore above his '''maximum''' mana.''
description3.text: Mana Surge does not trigger if Xerath would restore above his maximum mana.

notes.raw: * ''Mana Surge'' will trigger even if the attack is [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]], but not if it misses due to [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blind]]. * The empowered attack will trigger against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]]. * PENDING FOR TEST:: ''Mana Surge's '' interactions with [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodging]] effects.
notes.text:
Mana Surge will trigger even if the attack is blocked, but not if it misses due to blind.
The empowered attack will trigger against structures.
PENDING FOR TEST:: Mana Surge's interactions with dodging effects.
